description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableMessagePath' which implements the 'MessagePath' interface. It provides functionality to interpret and manipulate JSON pointers representing message paths, including extracting feature IDs and message directions, and adding or retrieving JSON pointer segments.

classes.name: ImmutableMessagePath
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the MessagePath interface that interprets JSON pointers as message paths, with methods to extract features and direction, and to manipulate pointer segments.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMessagePath instance from a given JsonPointer, ensuring its non-nullity.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID from the JSON pointer if present.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the message direction from the JSON pointer, if specified.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Adds a new leaf key to the current JSON pointer.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another JsonPointer to the current one.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON pointer is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonKey at a specified level.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root JsonKey of the pointer.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Returns the leaf JsonKey of the pointer.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Removes the leaf segment from the pointer.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Advances the pointer to the next level.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Retrieves a sub-pointer starting at a specific level.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Retrieves the prefix part of the pointer up to a specific level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts the pointer to a JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the pointer.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the pointer's string representation.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the JsonKeys in the pointer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the JSON pointer.
